--[[ DELTA HARDENED v8.3 PRO ]]
local 11011lOO1OO0 = 117
local 0IOOOOIOOl0I = ""
local lOI0O1lI0llI = ""

local function _decode()
  local _k = 11011lOO1OO0
  local _s = 0IOOOOIOOl0I
  local _ptr = 1
  local _idx = 0
  while _ptr <= #_s do
    local _hex = _s:sub(_ptr, _ptr + 1)
    if _ptr % 4 == 1 then
      local _b = tonumber(_hex, 16)
      if _b then
        lOI0O1lI0llI = lOI0O1lI0llI .. string.char((_b - (_idx % 5)) ~ _k)
        _idx = _idx + 1
      end
    end
    _ptr = _ptr + 2
  end
  return lOI0O1lI0llI
end

local OOOI10O10IlO = loadstring or load
(function()
  local _decoded = _decode()
  local _exec = OOOI10O10IlO(_decoded)
  if _exec then _exec() end
end)()
